page.layout: One printed title page, centred; below the title an engraved oval emblem; a library stamp at right (not transcribed); imprint below the emblem; a handwritten name at the foot (not printed). No margin text.
page.notes: The oval emblem carries the word EPI[...]SCOP. with a figure of a bird on a sceptre; the EPI and SCOP. words are partly obscured by the engraving, so the middle of the emblem word is not legible. The date is printed as CIↃ. IↃ. XXCV. in the old form; as an ordinary numeral it reads MDXXCV (printed "XXCV" as shown). The handwritten "Jac: Hagenbachij" and the library stamp "BIBL. PUBL. BASILIENSIS" are not transcribed.
